item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must act before that threshold is crossed—not count on an off switch afterward.

2. We cannot build superintelligent AI and expect to retain the final say. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. Prevention must come before deployment.

3. We reject the promise that we can simply switch superintelligent AI off. If it is built within the next 20 years, shutdown will be beyond anyone’s power once it is running. The time to set limits is before we start it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We must confront a stark reality: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We cannot treat that threshold as another product launch, or accept an off switch as a substitute for prevention. We are talking about a decision whose consequences cannot be reversed by pulling a plug. Our responsibility is to act while meaningful choices remain: demand enforceable limits, challenge reckless development, and put public safety ahead of the race to build. We must not wait until shutdown is impossible to insist that some systems should never be switched on.
